# Assignment Design Guide

Guidance for designing assignment content. Use the project assignment instructions for the required Markdown structure.

## Difficulty And Scope

- Target 2–4 tasks that build on each other.
- Start with something a student can finish in under 10 minutes, then add complexity.
- Keep the assignment focused on one core concept.

## Starter Code

Include starter code when the assignment needs boilerplate or a specific function signature. Skip it when writing the script from scratch is the learning goal.
